name: mini-harness
description: A supplementary layer over Codex: task tagging, an advisory pass (online researcher, diversifier, devil's advocate) in addition to the native flow, a repo memory the agent may consult, and per-run trajectories the harness learns from. Invoke with $mini-harness on.

interface.shortDescription: Supplementary harness: task tags, advisory subagents, repo memory, trajectories.
interface.longDescription: mini-harness adds a task tag, an advisory pass (online researcher, diversifier, devil's advocate) that runs in addition to Codex's own flow before execution, a repo memory the agent consults on need, and per-run trajectories consolidated into what helped and what hurt. Custom worker agents (.codex/agents) are installed with install.sh.
